Using debt at fair value NAVs were 449.89p excluding income and 451.98p including income (2.19p/0.49% and 4.28p/0.96% higher than the undiluted excluding figure, respectively). NAVs were calculated in accordance with Association of Investment Companies recommendations using bid/last-trade valuations, debt valued at par and market where applicable, and include provisions for performance fees.
